subtopic: Concept of Heat and its Units
stem: The SI unit of heat is ______.
solution: Heat is a form of energy, and the SI unit of energy is the joule (J). Calorie is the CGS unit of heat, while Kcal/kg \(^{\circ}\)C and Cal/g \(^{\circ}\)C are units of specific heat capacity. Hence the correct answer is (B) Joule.

stem: We can see the sun even when it is little below the horizon because of ______.
solution: Light from the sun bends (refracts) as it passes through layers of the atmosphere of increasing density (atmospheric refraction). Because of this bending, the sun appears raised above its actual position, so we can see it even when it is slightly below the horizon. Hence the correct answer is (B) Refraction of light.

stem: ______ is the functional group of carboxylic acid.
solution: The functional group of a carboxylic acid is the carboxyl group, \(-COOH\). (\(-CO-\) is the ketone group, \(-CHO\) is the aldehyde group and \(-OH\) is the alcohol group.) Hence the correct answer is (A) \(-COOH\).

stem: In simple microscope ______ lens is used.
solution: A simple microscope (magnifying glass) uses a single convex (converging) lens, which forms a virtual, erect and magnified image of an object placed within its focal length. Hence the correct answer is (D) Convex.

stem: In ______ process a layer of molten tin is deposited on metals.
solution: Tinning is the process of depositing a thin layer of molten tin over a metal (such as iron or copper) to protect it from corrosion. (Galvanizing deposits zinc, anodization forms an oxide layer, and alloying mixes metals.) Hence the correct answer is (B) Tinning.

stem: Write the name of the atom having the smallest size.
solution: Helium (He) is the atom with the smallest atomic size (atomic radius about 31 pm). Across a period atomic size decreases from left to right, and helium — being in Period 1 with the highest effective nuclear pull on its two electrons — has the smallest radius of all atoms.

stem: Write the molecular formula of calcium carbonate.
solution: The molecular formula of calcium carbonate is \(CaCO_3\). It is formed by one calcium ion \(Ca^{2+}\) and one carbonate ion \(CO_3^{2-}\).

A calorimeter is used to measure the quantity of heat exchanged (given out or absorbed) in a process, and thereby to determine the specific heat capacity of a substance using the principle of heat exchange (heat lost by the hot body = heat gained by the cold body).

stem:
Identify the hydrocarbon from the given electron-dot structure:

```
      H       H
      ..      ..
  H : C  :  C : H
      ..      ..
      H       H
```
solution: Each carbon atom shares one electron pair with the other carbon (a single \(C-C\) bond) and one electron pair with each of three hydrogen atoms. So each carbon is bonded to 3 hydrogen atoms and 1 carbon atom by single covalent bonds, giving the molecule \(C_2H_6\). The hydrocarbon is ethane (\(C_2H_6\)).
